readout_other: Emotional Face Assessment Task (EFAT) BOLD ROI estimates (amygdala, fusiform, thalamus); task accuracy and reaction time
direction_notes: Left and right amygdala activation to fearful/angry faces vs shapes decreased from pre to post sonication; fusiform gyrus and thalamus did not change.
safety_notes: Follow-up phone call and side-effect questionnaire; 'No serious adverse events were reported by any participants.' Estimated thermal dose 0.18 CEM43 over the session.

device.model: Pulsar 1002 LIFU pulsation system with a 65 mm transducer

timing.protocol_description: 30-s trains of 650 kHz sonication at PRF 10 Hz with 30-s rest periods, 10 cycles over 10 min; pulse width 5 ms, duty cycle 5%.

source_quotes.n_subjects: in a cohort of 10 healthy individuals.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: In succession, participants completed a pre-LIFU baseline fMRI, received 10- min of LIFU neuromodulation, and then repeated the baseline fMRI.
